cells.label: fact
cells.reason: The passages contain multiple explicit statements from executives describing how the firm converts workplace participants into wealth management clients through its client acquisition funnel and channel migration.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes its three channels—financial advisors, Workplace, and E*TRADE—as comprising its 'strategic client acquisition model,' positioning Workplace as the top of the funnel for acquiring wealth management clients.
items.quote: Our financial advisors, Workplace, and E*TRADE, each a category leader, which taken together comprise our strategic client acquisition model.

items.text: The CFO describes the funnel as beginning with retaining vested workplace assets (which translates into net new assets), followed over time by channel migration where workplace assets 'seek advice' and move into the adviser-led channel.
items.quote: The first is we retain those assets, and we'll see -- in this particular quarter, we saw greater asset retention from Workplace, which translated into NNA. And then over time ... we are seeing channel migration, and that's with technology and investment, where those Workplace assets are now actually seeking advice and that migration is something that has helped to contribute to over $1 trillion of total assets in our adviser-led strategy.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes 'channel migration' as workplace assets that began in the Workplace channel moving into the advisor-led channel, with $300 billion doing so since 2020.
items.quote: what I mean by channel migration is we have Workplace assets that began at some point in Workplace, and we're seeing them move into the advisor-led concept. Over the last five years or so, since 2020, we've seen $300 billion coming and initiating at some point from Workplace and moving into that advisor-led channel.

items.text: Morgan Stanley attributes the migration of workplace-originated assets into the advisor-led channel to its consistent investments in its differentiated platform.
items.quote: Assets that originated from workplace continue to migrate into our advisor-led channel as a result of the consistent investments we have made into our differentiated platform.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes Workplace as bringing relationships and assets onto the platform, and then delivering advice and solutions to those relationships to build fee-based assets.
items.quote: Workplace brings relationships and assets onto the platform, and we are well positioned to support these new relationships. ... We continue to deliver advice and solutions to new and existing relationships, supporting the build in our fee-based assets.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes its Morgan Stanley at Work business as positioning it as an early trusted advisor to private companies, where employees benefit from management of equity compensation plans, liquidity opportunities, and full-service advice as companies grow.
items.quote: Our Morgan Stanley at Work business, with its exclusive partnership with Carta, positions us as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies. As workplace companies grow, we can provide traditional institutional servicing. Employees across our workplace companies benefit from our management of equity compensation plans, liquidity opportunities, and our full-service advice.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes its investments in the self-directed and Workplace channels as driving its 'differentiated client acquisition funnel.'
items.quote: In Wealth Management, investments in our self-directed and Workplace channels drive our differentiated client acquisition funnel.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that 70% of the flows originating from workplace are net new assets to the firm.
items.quote: 70% of the flows that come from workplace, that originate from workplace, is actually net new assets to the firm.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that since 2020 it has generated over $400 billion of new adviser-led assets from relationships that originated from either Workplace or E*TRADE.
items.quote: Since 2020, we have generated over $400 billion of new adviser-led assets from relationships that originated from either Workplace or E*TRADE.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes a referral-based partnership with Carta under which private companies moving from private to public are referred to Morgan Stanley, supporting conversion into its platform.
items.quote: The original relationship started as a referral-based model. As companies began to move from a private side to a public side, they would be referred to Morgan Stanley.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic-update deck depicts a client lifecycle in which workplace founders and employees move from financial wellness and equity compensation through to 'Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation' as companies go public.
items.quote: Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits ... Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation ... IPO Execution and Support Services
